# Operations

<!-- Written by build_operations. Do not edit it here. -->

## Reading the channels

The robots file is read once a run. A four oh four forbids nothing and anything else that is not a page forbids everything.

A review page is assumed to carry 10 reviews when working out how many pages a shortfall is worth.

A listing is reconfirmed every 18 months. A stale one is skipped and named in the plan.

A profile is called stale after 3 pages in a row give nothing up, and watched when more than 50% of the blocks across the last 6 pages were dropped.

## The sample

Regime version 1. The window is the last 24 months and at least 2 independent channels are wanted.

| season | base quota | before the multipliers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| peak | 8 | 8 |
| shoulder | 5 | 5 |
| off | 3 | 3 |

The band and the size of the premises multiply the base. A season the operator is shut for is not sampled at all.

A review of fewer than 12 words counts towards the sample and never carries an assertion.

Two reviews are the same review above 82% overlap and worth looking at above 58%.

## Weighing what was found

A rule weighs one to 5. Weight halves over the half life of its kind and never falls below 15% of what it started at.

| kind | half life |
| --- | --- |
| structural | 24 months |
| transient | 6 months |

## What happens next

| disposition | score | access score |
| --- | --- | --- |
| desk enquiry | 3 | - |
| re-inspection | 7 | 5 |
| urgent re-inspection | 14 | 9 |

A sample that is not complete holds the disposition at a desk enquiry however heavy the evidence is.

An accepted remediation notice cuts a structural finding from before the work to 20% and a transient one to 5%.

## Sending somebody out

A visit lands at least 2 working days after the decision, inside the licence period, and never in a month the operator says they are shut.

| disposition | target |
| --- | --- |
| urgent re-inspection | 10 working days |
| re-inspection | 40 working days |

## What an exit code means

| code | why |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | error |
| 2 | invalid |
| 3 | not_found |
| 4 | already_exists |
| 5 | conflict |
| 6 | fetch_failed |
| 7 | refused |
